issues.detail: The Greek text says 'οτι ισχυρος κυριος ο θεος' (because the Lord God is mighty), but the Vietnamese translation places 'là Đấng mạnh mẽ' at the end of the sentence as a non-restrictive appositive to 'Đấng phán xét', which slightly alters the grammatical flow, though the primary issue is the word order/structure regarding the reason.

The Vietnamese translation moves the attribute 'mạnh mẽ' (strong/mighty) to the very end of the sentence, whereas in Greek it immediately follows 'κυριος' (Lord). While the meaning is largely preserved, the Vietnamese structure makes 'mạnh mẽ' appear as a secondary description of the Judge rather than the primary reason provided by the 'oti' clause.
